fields.statement: At 33055a5c, go test -trimpath -count=1 ./cmd/rhiza -run 'TestScripts/plan-requests$' passes. With a fake rex and rhiza.autonomy.plan=auto, the daemon pass detaches the milestone request 'Ship v2' as run start ... --milestone (line ending there, and ! stdout 'Ship v2.*--autonomous'), the second feature request 'Add search' as ... --autonomous and the bug as ... --autonomous. Starting the milestone run as the daemon said leaves its journal's started entry with no "autonomous":true (count 0). I confirmed in a scratch copy of the script that request 3 is the milestone and that an autonomous run's journal does contain "autonomous":true, so the 0 check means something. The diff in internal/api/request.go daemonStartPlan sets autonomous=false for KindMilestone only, so feature and bug requests still follow rhiza.autonomy.plan.
